scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm run example:compile && tsx --test tests/*.test.ts
scripts.example:compile: node dist/cli.js compile examples/counter/Counter.meeko examples/counter/Counter.generated.ts && node dist/cli.js compile examples/attributes/Attributes.meeko examples/attributes/Attributes.generated.ts && node dist/cli.js compile examples/regions/Regions.meeko examples/regions/Regions.generated.ts && node dist/cli.js compile examples/primitives/Primitives.meeko examples/primitives/Primitives.generated.ts
scripts.example:bundle: pnpm run build && pnpm run example:compile && esbuild examples/counter/client.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --target=es2022 --outfile=examples/counter/client.bundle.js
scripts.vite:types: pnpm run build && node dist/cli.js types examples/counter/Counter.meeko && node dist/cli.js types examples/regions/Regions.meeko && node dist/cli.js types examples/vite/Hot.meeko && node dist/cli.js types examples/nested/Parent.meeko && tsc -p examples/vite/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.e2e: pnpm run example:bundle && pnpm run vite:build && tsx --test tests/browser.e2e.ts
scripts.benchmark: pnpm run build && pnpm run benchmark:check && node --expose-gc --import tsx benchmarks/run.ts
scripts.verify: pnpm run check && pnpm run test && pnpm run example:check && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && pnpm run vite:types && pnpm run benchmark:check && pnpm run vite:build
